scientific_integrity: The unlimited-size theorem is proved algebraically; small-graph exhaustive computation checks the formula but does not substitute for that proof. Independently authored mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for connected finite loopless undirected graphs with at least two vertices; no assertion for isolated vertices or disconnected graphs. Prior literature comparisons are not an independent exhaustive publication-priority certification.
title: Independent sets and false twins determine all graph-quandle retraction ranks
